info.name: Dojo Terminal sessions API
info.description:
# Introduction

The Dojo API is a REST API, using HTTP response codes to convey status, including successful responses and errors.

Contact Support:
 Name: Dojo Developer Experience Team

item.name: Request the cancellation of a terminal session

header.description: (Required) The API version with format yyyy-mm-dd. The current version is `2026-02-27`.

(Required) This field shows the EPOS company whose software is generating the request. This value should not be configurable as it will remain the same for all customers using particular EPOS software.
This identifies the reseller of the EPOS. This may be the same as the `software-house-id` if they are also the seller.

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the terminal session.

response.name: Terminal session requested to be canceled.
